# planetscale_neki_shards (Data Source)

NekiShards DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "planetscale_neki_shards" "my_nekishards" {
  branch                        = "...my_branch..."
  database                      = "...my_database..."
  exclude_configuration_profile = "...my_exclude_configuration_profile..."
  organization                  = "...my_organization..."
  q                             = "...my_q..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String)
- `database` (String)
- `organization` (String)

### Optional

- `exclude_configuration_profile` (String)
- `q` (String)

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `total_count` (Number)
- `total_pages` (Number)
- `type` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `configuration_profile` (String) The name of the shard configuration profile.
- `created_at` (String)
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the shard.
- `id` (String) The ID of the shard.
- `name` (String) The internal name of the shard.
